title: Te Kaiwhakapono Huna
intro: I roto i ngā whare rangatira o te mana, i te wāhi i kingi ai te whakaponokore me te tukino, ka puta mai he reo kotahi o te pono i tētahi wāhi kāore i whakaarohia. I werohia e tēnei tangata te mana ki te tiaki i tētahi karere, me te tūpono i tōna ake haumarutanga ki te kauwhau i te pono.
clues: I noho ahau i tētahi whenua tino tukino, e mahi ana ki tētahi rangatira e kī ana he atua ia.
I huna e au aku whakapono pono mō ngā tau maha, i te wehi i ngā hua o te whakakitenga mai.
I te taenga mai o tētahi karere me ngā tohu mārama, i whakapono ahau, engari i whakatakoto whakaaro tōku iwi ki a ia.
I tū ahau i mua i te kaitukino me tana kaunihera, me te tautohe kia kaua rātou e patu i tētahi karere harakore.
I whakatūpato ahau i a rātou mō te whiu o ngā iwi o mua i whakakahore i te pono, pērā i te iwi o Noa rāua ko 'Āta.
I whakaorangia ahau e Allah i ā rātou mahi kino, ā, i kite ahau i te whakangaromanga o te kāwanatanga tukino.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
